class.name: VECSQueryBuilder
class.brief_description:
A fluent, chainable query builder for the ECS world.
面向 ECS 世界的流畅链式查询构建器。
class.description:
[b]VECSQueryBuilder[/b] describes which entities to select. Every term method returns [code]this[/code] so calls can be chained, then one of the terminal methods runs the query:
[codeblock] var hits: Array = world.query() \ .with_all(["Position", "Velocity"]) \ .enabled() \ .execute() [/codeblock]
Query construction is cheap — matching is cached incrementally in the core, so repeated queries cost little. Obtain a builder from [method VECSWorld.query].
[b]VECSQueryBuilder[/b] 描述要选择哪些实体。每个条件方法都返回 [code]this[/code] 以支持链式调用，最后由某个终结方法执行查询：
[codeblock] var hits: Array = world.query() \ .with_all(["Position", "Velocity"]) \ .enabled() \ .execute() [/codeblock]
查询构建开销很低——核心会增量缓存匹配结果，因此重复查询成本很小。通过 [method VECSWorld.query] 获取构建器。

method.name: changed
method.description:
Restricts the query to entities whose named components were written since the previous execution of a query with the same membership and changed set. The baseline is tracked per query, so filters do not interfere. Ideal for sparse, event-driven systems.
把查询限制为：其指定组件自"具有相同成员与变更集的查询上次执行以来"被写入过的实体。基线按查询分别跟踪，过滤器互不干扰。非常适合稀疏、事件驱动的系统。

method.name: count
method.description:
Returns the number of matching entities without materializing them.
返回匹配实体数量而不物化它们。

method.name: enabled
method.description:
Restricts the query to entities whose enabled flag is set (via [method VECSSystem]-independent entity enable/disable state).
把查询限制为启用了 enabled 标记的实体（通过与 [method VECSSystem] 无关的实体启用/禁用状态）。

method.name: execute
method.description:
Runs the query and returns an [Array] of matching [VECSEntity] handles. For large result sets consider [method VECSWorld.each] to avoid materializing the array.
执行查询并返回匹配 [VECSEntity] 句柄的 [Array]。结果集很大时，可考虑 [method VECSWorld.each] 以避免物化数组。

method.name: execute_one
method.description:
Runs the query and returns the first matching entity (or a null handle if none match). Honors the same filters as [method execute], including [method changed].
执行查询并返回第一个匹配实体（无匹配则返回空句柄）。遵守与 [method execute] 相同的过滤器，包括 [method changed]。

method.name: field_equals
method.description:
Restricts the query to entities that carry component [param comp] AND whose field [param field] value equals [param value]. The comparison runs entirely in C++ (no per-entity GDScript callback), so the "query the whole table then hand-compare the owner field" scan collapses to one filtered query:
[codeblock] var owned := world.query() \ .with_all(["Combatant"]) \ .field_equals("Combatant", "owner", eid) \ .execute() [/codeblock]
Chainable: each call adds one equality constraint; all must hold (AND). Applied by [method execute], [method execute_one] and [method count], alongside the other filters. Equality follows GDScript [code]==[/code] semantics, so an I64 field matches an int and an F32 field matches a float (an F32 [code]0.0[/code] matches an int [code]0[/code]). An unknown component is ignored with an error printed (the term does not filter).
把查询限制为：实体携带组件 [param comp] 且其字段 [param field] 的值等于 [param value]。比较完全在 C++ 侧进行（无逐实体 GDScript 回调），因此"全表查询再手比 owner 字段"的扫描可收缩为一条过滤查询：
[codeblock] var owned := world.query() \ .with_all(["Combatant"]) \ .field_equals("Combatant", "owner", eid) \ .execute() [/codeblock]
可链式调用：每次调用新增一条相等约束，须全部满足（AND）。[method execute]、[method execute_one] 与 [method count] 都会应用，并与其他过滤器组合。相等比较遵循 GDScript [code]==[/code] 语义，因此 I64 字段匹配 int，F32 字段匹配 float（F32 [code]0.0[/code] 匹配 int [code]0[/code]）。未知组件会被忽略并打印错误（该条件不生效）。

method.name: get_last_execution_time_usec
method.description:
Returns the number of microseconds spent in the most recent [method execute] call. [code]0[/code] until the first execution. Useful for profiling and the editor inspector.
返回最近一次 [method execute] 调用所花费的微秒数。首次执行前为 [code]0[/code]。可用于性能分析与编辑器检查器。

method.name: order_by
method.description:
Sorts [method execute] results ascending by the value of the field [param field] on component [param comp] (stable sort; equal values keep their previous order). [method execute_one] / [method count] are unaffected. The default order is archetype creation order, then row order.
按组件 [param comp] 上字段 [param field] 的值对 [method execute] 结果升序排序（稳定排序；相等值保持原顺序）。[method execute_one] / [method count] 不受影响。默认顺序为 archetype 创建序加行序。

method.name: order_by_id
method.description:
Sorts [method execute] results ascending by raw entity id (stable sort). Useful for deterministic iteration order across ticks.
按原始实体 id 对 [method execute] 结果升序排序（稳定排序）。便于跨 tick 获得确定的迭代顺序。

method.name: where
method.description:
Predicate filter: only entities for which [code]predicate(entity)[/code] is truthy are returned. The callable receives a [VECSEntity] and returns a bool. Applied by [method execute], [method execute_one] and [method count]. Combine with the term filters (e.g. [method with_all]) for complex selections.
谓词过滤器：只返回使 [code]predicate(entity)[/code] 为真的实体。回调接收一个 [VECSEntity] 并返回 bool。[method execute]、[method execute_one] 与 [method count] 都会应用。可与条件过滤器（如 [method with_all]）组合进行复杂选择。

method.name: with_all
method.description:
Requires the entity to have every component named in [param names]. Unknown names are ignored with an error printed.
要求实体拥有 [param names] 中列出的全部组件。未知名称会被忽略并打印错误。

method.name: with_any
method.description:
Requires the entity to have at least one of the components named in [param names].
要求实体拥有 [param names] 中列出的至少一个组件。

method.name: with_none
method.description:
Requires the entity to have none of the components named in [param names].
要求实体不拥有 [param names] 中列出的任何组件。
